description: This file defines the BooleanQueryProvider class, which implements ILuceneQueryProvider to create Lucene boolean queries based on JSON input, including handling filters and different query clauses.

classes.name: BooleanQueryProvider
classes.description: Provides Lucene boolean queries based on JSON input, supporting filters and various boolean clauses.

methods.name: CreateQuery
methods.description: Creates a Lucene boolean query from JSON input, handling 'must', 'should', 'must_not', 'boost', 'minimum_should_match', and 'filter' clauses.

methods.name: CreateFilteredQuery
methods.description: Creates a filtered Lucene query based on filter JSON nodes, utilizing registered filter providers.
